# immich_asset (Resource)

Create an Immich asset (image or video).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "immich_asset" "image" {
  asset_data  = filebase64("picture.jpg")
  filename    = "image.jpg"
  created_at  = "2026-10-11T12:12:11+11:00"
  modified_at = "2026-10-11T12:12:11+11:00"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asset_data` (String) Image data in base64 format.
- `created_at` (String) Creation date/time in ISO8601 format.
- `filename` (String) Filename as will be stored in the server. Has no bearing on local filename from which data is read.
- `modified_at` (String) Last modification date/time in ISO8601 format.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The asset ID.
